polity.canonical_name_en: Government of the Grand National Assembly

activity.role: Speaker of the Grand National Assembly
activity.notes: Mustafa Kemal was elected Speaker of the Grand National Assembly on 24 April 1920 and remained in that office until he was elected President of the Republic on 29 October 1923. This Activity represents his leadership of the Ankara-based assembly-government during the Turkish War of Independence and is intentionally separate from his 1923–1938 presidency of Turkey; it does not assert personal sovereign rule over the assembly government.

sources.title: Meclis Başkanlarımız — Türkiye Büyük Millet Meclisi
sources.citation_text: The official TBMM list gives Mustafa Kemal Atatürk’s speakership as 24 April 1920 to 29 October 1923.

sources.title: 1921 Anayasası’nın Kabul Edilişinin 100. Yılı Ulusal Sempozyumu — TBMM
sources.citation_text: TBMM scholarship explains that Mustafa Kemal was elected Assembly President on 24 April 1920 and that the assembly-government model combined legislative and executive authority.
